build_PoseLinearProbe: build a PoseLinearProbe model with an AttentivePooler and three MLP probes for tx, ty, and yaw pose classification
build_PoseSLModule: build a PoseSLModule training module that combines a vision encoder with a PoseLinearProbe task head for 6D pose estimation
run_PoseSLModule_training_step: run a training step on a batch of images and pose labels to compute cross-entropy loss and accuracy metrics
run_PoseSLModule_validation_step: run a validation step that computes top-k accuracy, balanced accuracy, and per-class metrics for pose predictions
review_PoseSLModule_on_validation_epoch_: review the on_validation_epoch_end method that generates and logs normalized confusion matrix plots for tx, ty, and yaw pose classes
